newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian commercial vehicle sales rise in June.
newsitem.headline: Italian commercial vehicle sales rise in June.

text.p: Italian commercial vehicle sales rose 7.25 percent to 13,673 in June year on year but sales in the first half of 1997 fell 4.48 percent to 75,363, Italian automakers' association Anfia and importing body Unrae said.
Italian domestic manufacturers saw their June market share slip to 58.19 percent from 58.83 percent with a total of 7,956 vehicles.
Fiat Auto sales dropped 5.08 percent to 5,638 but Fiat's truck unit Iveco saw a 48.4 percent jump to 1,680 while light van maker Piaggio sales rose 50.13 percent to 590.

Among imported trucks, Ford sales fell 19.6 percent to 1,363 while Nissan rose 17.9 percent to 880, Mercedes rose 24.3 percent to 792, Renault sales rose 6.94 percent to 570 and Volkswagen sales rose 2.04 percent to 599.
Peugeot sales jumped 316 percent to 312 vehicles, Citroen rose 50.7 percent to 380, Hyundai rose 77.7 percent to 80 and Tata rose 68.7 percent to 81 sales.
